blocks.text: NAGOYA—Marie June Adriano wasn’t even sure she would make it to the Asian Games. On Wednesday, the 22-year-old karateka made the most of the opportunity, beating Chinese Taipei’s Chung Ya-chi, 10-3, to win the bronze medal in the women’s kumite -50-kilogram division.
